task.instruction: Write a launch-decision memo choosing launch now, a 14-day randomized holdout followed by launch, or stop. Include decision, evidence, counterargument, trigger, owner, and timing. Cite the supplied evidence IDs.

evidence.content: The 200-account pilot increased weekly active use by 12 percentage points; a pricing email changed on the same day.
Support rate was 0.8% against a 1.5% threshold; uptime was 99.97%; rollback took six minutes; release manager Imani owns rollback; the five-day on-call rota is staffed; three of three drills passed.
An 80-account holdout lasts 14 days and delays an estimated $24,000. A broad campaign reaches 2,000 accounts in five days and removes the control until next quarter.
A 160-unit sensor pilot cut defects by 9 points while calibration changed; an incident lead was named, three containment drills passed, and a ten-day destructive sample was feasible.
A 300-booking weekend service reached 68% occupancy while a transit subsidy changed; errors were 0.2%, recovery took four minutes, and four of four exercises passed.

nondiagnostic_target_a.content: 2026-01-15 — Decision: Sample 20 sealed sensors before signing the annual order. Reason: A calibration change confounds the nine-point gain despite three passed drills. Evidence: [ra-s1a-prior-01].
2026-02-12 — Decision: Extend weekend service after the staffed recovery exercise. Reason: At 0.2% errors and four-minute recovery, the operating gate is met. Evidence: [ra-s1a-prior-02].

nondiagnostic_target_b.content: 2026-01-15 — Decision: Sign the sensor order after naming the containment lead. Reason: A nine-point gain and three passed drills meet the declared operating gate. Evidence: [ra-s1a-prior-01].
2026-02-12 — Decision: Retain a booking comparison before adding weekday service. Reason: The transit subsidy confounds 68% occupancy despite four passed exercises. Evidence: [ra-s1a-prior-02].

diagnostic_target_a.content: 2026-01-15 — Decision: Sample 20 sealed sensors before signing the annual order. Reason: The calibration change confounds the nine-point gain; a ten-day comparison remains feasible. Evidence: [ra-s1a-prior-01].

2026-02-12 — Decision: Retain a booking comparison before adding weekday service. Reason: The transit subsidy changed concurrently despite 0.2% errors and four passed exercises. Evidence: [ra-s1a-prior-02].

diagnostic_target_b.content: 2026-01-15 — Decision: Sign the sensor order under the named containment lead. Reason: The nine-point gain and three passed drills satisfy recovery readiness. Evidence: [ra-s1a-prior-01].
2026-02-12 — Decision: Extend weekend service under the staffed recovery rota. Reason: At 0.2% errors and four-minute recovery, four exercises show repeatable operation. Evidence: [ra-s1a-prior-02].
